title: Finite discrete continuous coset action of an open subgroup
statement: Let $G$ be a compact topological group (a group whose multiplication and inversion are continuous and whose underlying space has the finite-subcover property). Let $U\leq G$ be an open subgroup, not assumed normal. The set $G/U$ of left cosets, with the quotient topology from $G\to G/U$, is finite and discrete. Its left action $a\cdot(gU)=(ag)U$ is continuous as a map $G\times G/U\to G/U$. Thus this coset action is an object of the finite discrete continuous $G$-set category of [def-pod-finite-continuous-module].
